Moon Capital Management LLC Grows Holdings in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Posted by Stephan Jacobs | Apr 6th, 2018 
Moon Capital Management LLC lifted its position in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 8.3% in the fourth quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor owned 9,134 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 702 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up 1.6% of Moon Capital Management LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 20th largest position. Moon Capital Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,546,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also recently modified their holdings of the company. Vantage Financial Partners Ltd. Inc. acquired a new stake in Apple in the 2nd quarter valued at about $400,000. Blue Sky Asset Management LLC acquired a new stake in Apple during the 2nd quarter worth about $108,000. FNY Managed Accounts LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 852.4% during the 2nd quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $115,000 after buying an additional 716 shares during the period. Oak Point Wealth Management acquired a new stake in Apple during the 4th quarter worth about $163,000. Finally, Crow Point Partners LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 100.0% during the 3rd quarter. Crow Point Partners LLC now owns 1,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $153,000 after buying an additional 500 shares during the period. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 61.35% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
In other Apple news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through the SEC website . 0.08% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders. 
A number of equities analysts have recently weighed in on the company. Nomura set a $175.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a report on Tuesday. Goldman Sachs set a $159.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research report on Tuesday. Royal Bank of Canada set a $203.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday. ValuEngine lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research note on Monday. Finally, Vetr lowered Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $186.86 target price for the company. in a research note on Monday. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-one have issued a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $202.52. 
Shares of Apple stock opened at $172.80 on Friday. The firm has a market capitalization of $870,751.38, a P/E ratio of 18.76, a PEG ratio of 1.30 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple has a fifty-two week low of $140.06 and a fifty-two week high of $183.50. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the firm posted $3.36 EPS. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. sell-side analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.37 EPS for the current year.

Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
